title: Expense Reimbursement Policy — Operations Division
content: Operations Division employees at Acme Corp may submit expense claims for client entertainment up to $150 per event. All claims must be approved by the employee's direct manager before submission. Software subscriptions required for project work are reimbursable up to $50 per month per employee. Home office supplies (printer paper, pens, notebooks) are reimbursable up to $30 per quarter. Expenses exceeding these limits require Director-level approval. Reimbursements are processed within 15 business days of a complete submission.
